authorization: Product-owner authorised a bounded successor-baseline migration removing the active SafeScope code/API namespace, explicitly permitting the §259 candidate identity to change for naming/path changes with no semantic behaviour change.
whyThisFileExists: Frozen verification manifests record 1246 members by repository-relative path under backend/src/safescope-v2/. An authorised rename makes those paths absent, and the evidence guard correctly treats an absent member as a fault. This record is NOT a baseline and does not excuse absence: it states where each member moved, and the guard must still find a file at the migrated path. A member that resolves nowhere still fails. Content drift at the migrated path is tolerated exactly as it already is for any repository source a manifest points at.
notABaseline: Nothing here is added to verification/current/EVIDENCE-BASELINE.json. Absorbing these into the baseline would have been weakening a gate to obtain a pass.
